description: Calendar year of the year-end holdings snapshot.
teaching_note: A snapshot date, not a transaction year.

description: Official reporting date for the holdings snapshot.
teaching_note: Use this when exact timing matters.

description: NBIM geographic region assigned to the investment market.
teaching_note: Categories may change over a long historical period.

description: NBIM country or market assigned to the holding.
teaching_note: This is not necessarily the incorporation country.

description: Company or issuer name as published by NBIM.
teaching_note: Names are not stable identifiers; mergers and renaming complicate longitudinal matching.

description: NBIM industry classification for the holding.
Year-end market value of the holding in Norwegian kroner.
teaching_note: Best monetary field for comparisons across years, but values are nominal and reflect prices, currencies, purchases, and sales.

description: Year-end market value of the holding converted to US dollars.
teaching_note: Useful for a single snapshot; exchange-rate changes affect comparisons across years.

description: Voting rights held, stored in percentage points.
teaching_note: Do not divide by 100 unless a calculation needs a 0–1 proportion.

description: Equity ownership held, stored in percentage points.
teaching_note: This is a stake, not a financial return.

description: Legal country of incorporation supplied by NBIM.
teaching_note: Compare with country to distinguish incorporation from the investment market.

description: Name of the archived official annual Excel file.
Official NBIM API URL for the annual source file.
teaching_note: The URL includes the asset type and report date.
